description: This file defines the class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleCallButton', which extends 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate'. It provides functionality to generate a form for scheduling a call within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment, including methods for forming HTML form markup and displaying a button based on access control.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleCallButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a button to schedule calls within a subpanel context in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML form as a string for scheduling a call, including hidden inputs with relevant context and additional form fields.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the scheduling button if the user has 'EditView' access; otherwise returns an empty string.
